change_justification.flaw: v1 negative-control rule compared the shuffled-label policy against no-trade only; in a drifting market any exposure can beat no-trade, so the control can trigger NO_GO (or pass) for reasons unrelated to label leakage.
change_justification.fix: v2 requires the shuffled-label control to also exceed its exposure-matched random distribution (same per-session pick counts, R repetitions) by more than two standard deviations before it invalidates the run.

hypothesis.primary: A constrained 10-slot daily-close tabular-Q policy on D-1 daily-DB features with exact 15:20 proxy execution achieves validation economic NAV above no-trade and at least equal to the best frozen RULE/random baseline at 0.23% round-trip cost, in a majority of seeds.
hypothesis.null: The policy does not satisfy the criterion in a majority of seeds net of 0.23% cost on validation.
negative_controls: shuffled-label control must NOT exceed max(no_trade, exposure-matched random mean + 2*std) at primary cost
zero-cost scenario is display-only and never used for the verdict

splits.embargo: rows whose max-horizon exit crosses a split boundary are dropped

hyperparams_frozen.early_stop: rolling-3 val NAV declines 3 consecutive checks after episode 10

exposure_matched_random.definition: for each shuffled-label control seed, replay the same per-session pick counts with uniformly random distinct symbols

verdict_rules.negative_control_fail: any shuffled seed final val NAV > max(60000000, exposure_matched mean + 2*std) => NO_GO
verdict_rules.go_candidate: >=3 of 5 seeds with val NAV > 60000000 AND >= best of (rule/random baselines) => GO_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_ONLY
verdict_rules.test_oos: untouched test split is read once only if GO_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_ONLY; otherwise NOT_RUN
verdict_rules.post_hoc_retune: forbidden; any change requires a new preregistration version
